name: Calendar
description: Your calendar: agenda, 3 days, week, month and year, scrolling sideways through dates, with events to make, move and change, repeating ones too. From Google Calendar, or in Previews the Sample calendar.

data:calendar:read.why: Show your events, and the events notes link to

data:calendar:write.why: Add, move and change events when you do

files:read.why: See whether an event's meeting note is there already

files:write.why: Make a meeting note for an event, when you ask

editor.why: Draw links to events in notes as their time and title

dataSources.title: Calendar
dataSources.description: Events from Google Calendar, kept as records with history.

calendar.days.description: How many days ahead the Calendar side panel shows.

calendar.view.description: The view the Calendar tab opens on, the first time.

calendar.startHour.description: The hour the time grid opens scrolled to.

calendar.meetingNotes.description: The folder Create meeting note puts notes in.

calendar.linkBack.description: When you make a meeting note, add a link to it to the event's description. That changes the event for everyone invited.
